content.short: Circle Yield enables institutional investors to lend USDC in overcollateralized loans to earn interest.
content.description: Circle Yield is a yield-earning program for USDC holders that began in June 2021 to let institutional investors earn interest by lending USDC. Participants deposit a minimum of 100,000 USDC, which is lent to Circle Bermuda and allocated to investment partners who deploy it in the capital crypto markets. The program pays interest in USDC, with weekly rate updates and loan terms ranging from one to twelve months.
